title: The Minister's Dilemma
description: Gregor Maric and Elara Vostane are in open disagreement about the pace of budget consolidation. The workers are hurting. The deficit is real. You have to choose which truth hurts less.

title: Budget Allocation — Fiscal Review
description: With the first quarter projections in from Vostane, the budget allocations need review. The IMA conditions are approaching — adjust spending before they adjust it for you.

title: The Architect's Question
description: Jonas is still waiting for that conversation. He's been patient. The patience is running out.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora is waiting. She knows you're busy. She also knows that 'busy' is starting to sound like 'avoiding.'
